reason_codes.meaning: All six serving fields are exactly equal and continuing legal support is proved, so the predecessor record is reused.
At least one serving field changed and a new Register-issued immutable record identity is used.
A non-searchable disposition emits no serving record.
Exact bytes cannot be reused without continuing legal support.
The ordinary update path requires a preserved predecessor record.
Exact serving bytes must reuse the predecessor identity rather than allocate a duplicate.
Changed serving bytes cannot overwrite an existing immutable record identity.
Changed serving bytes require a new Register-issued record identity.
